Alex (CS): Heads-up — prepping pre-QBR packet for Starlane. Need token econ snapshots, 3‑mo spend forecast, and any unusual embed-heavy spikes. Goal: draft by Tue EOD.
Marina: Working on spend forecast, can pull last 90d usage + projected ramp. Need current commit and retainer info from Finance.
Chris - FinOps: I have commit numbers. Sending csv to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/example (will post full path). Expect to post by Mon morning.
Sam T.: Can someone paste recent throttle incidents? Need to explain mitigations in QBR.
Emily (Onboarding): Customer reported a 2x embed burst after product launch last week — captured feedback: wants recommendations for caching and rate limits. I'll add notes.
Alex (CS): Nice. Also we should add a 1-slide 'Cost mitigation options' with estimated unit cost impact for: batching, KV cache, model quantization. Marina, can you draft rough % reductions?
Marina: Quick estimates: batching ~12–25% depending on seq len, cache ~20–40% for prefix-heavy calls, quantization ~30% for compatible models. I'll attach sample calc.
Chris - FinOps: FYI - don't promise exact % in slides. Use ranges and call out assumptions (seq length, request mix, cache hit rate). I'll give commit-adjusted $ forecasts.
Sam T.: For the slide deck, propose this layout: 1) topline spend & run rate 2) usage breakdown by endpoint 3) incidents & ops notes 4) mitigation options & estimated impact 5) enablement ask (workshop/training). Thoughts?
Emily (Onboarding): +1. I'll lead the enablement ask — offer a 30-min workshop on cache/batching. Who can present the demo?
Alex (CS): @Sam T. you have bandwidth to demo batching configs? otherwise @Marina can walk through numbers.
Sam T.: I can do a 20-min demo. will prep a short script. Need sample prompt set from the customer — Emily, can you get that?
Emily (Onboarding): On it. I'll request their top 10 prompt flows and share by Monday.
runbot: Reminder: create QBR packet folder and add 'pre-qbr/3067890123' template.
Chris - FinOps: Added forecast file: /drive/qbrs/starlane/forecast_Mar.csv
Alex (CS): Action list: Emily to get prompt set (due Mon), Marina to post numbers (Mon), Chris to finalize $ forecasts (Mon), Sam to prepare demo (Tue), Alex to assemble deck (Tue EOD). Please react with :white_check_mark: when assigned.
Marina: :white_check_mark:
Chris - FinOps: :white_check_mark:
Sam T.: :white_check_mark:
Emily (Onboarding): :white_check_mark:
Alex (CS): Thanks team — we'll sync Tue 10am standup if needed.
